Educational ownership-cost calculator

EV, hybrid, and gas car ownership costs

The calculation combines purchase price, fuel or charging, maintenance, insurance, taxes, depreciation, resale value, and incentives for three vehicle types over the selected period.

Educational car cost comparison tool, not a vehicle quote or precise finance calculator. Illustrative defaults only.

EV, hybrid, and gas car comparison

Gas / combustion car

Lower upfront cost

Often cheaper to buy, but fuel, repairs, taxes, and depreciation can add up over time.

Hybrid

Middle-ground fuel savings

Improves fuel economy without requiring home charging or public charging access.

Electric vehicle (EV)

Lower charging and maintenance cost

Can become cheaper when mileage is high, home charging is available, and resale value holds.

Model notes

Cost calculator notes

  • Similar vehicle size and use case assumed.
  • Vehicle archetypes, not exact models.
  • Local tax, subsidy, energy, and resale rules matter.
  • Currency and distance settings are display conversions.
  • EV incentives and remissions can expire.
  • Depreciation and battery outcomes are uncertain.
  • Plug-in hybrids are outside this version.
